summary: Joined lane paths with continuous cached cubic junction arcs while retaining pure hour-driven motion and eight-second dwells. Added four base bus colours, roof and body detail, passenger lighting and ground pools; separated route ribbons with chevrons and white stop rings; replaced all transit DOM labels with one geometry batch. Corrected occupancy fractions, actual populated road-distance catchments, cached demand refresh and JSON-safe zero-fleet saves. Owner functionality is substantially stronger; visual and literal rendering requirements remain below target.
acceptanceMet: Zero final console errors and ready transit across 16 final gauntlet captures, all six transit presets, 720p HUD and overlay, a second seed and showcase all.

Directed graph search, road adjacency and return leg; actual connector endpoint gap 0 m, bisection 0.000002200001745 m, lane error 0 outside marked junctions and junction road distance at most 4.4731 m.
All 24 scheduled stop dwells remain exactly eight seconds; repeated hour and save restoration reproduce fleet poses. Runtime occupancy is a fraction with independent riders count.

Road-distance catchments exclude a geographically near disconnected street; actual simulation zero occupants and jobs stay zero. A six-occupant public restore changes demand and emits one completed event batch, without treasury mutation or catchment Dijkstra per tick.
Atomic private new/edit draft cancellation, duplicate begin, rejected invalid commit, valid single-event commit, nonfinite hover clear and post-commit cancel preservation.

Actual HUD events change fleet; awaited IndexedDB save/load restores it. Invalid saves reject atomically, exact legacy empty object clears outgoing state, zero-fleet serialized headway null roundtrips exactly and restores runtime Infinity.
Props shelters are adopted without mutation or duplicates; no roads or props ownership escape. Road removal disables affected lines and empty city initializes with zero errors.
No transit DOM output. Near overlay at 720p has three measured world-anchored chip bounds of 103 to 104 by 21 px, within HUD exclusions and the 260 m cull distance.
Actual callback counts at most 20 owned calls and 73,564 triangles in the stable eight-view sample; offscreen zero draws. Mean update 0.024 ms over 100 samples, maximum 0.9 ms on Apple M4 Metal.
acceptanceMissed: Visual quality remains below the 8.5 target: opaque slab glazing, simple interior silhouettes, boxy panels and a BUS glyph rather than a real route destination display.

The literal pinned crop noise test still fails: bus day maximum 184.84/255 with 3,075 pixels above 40; night 182.99 with 3,040. These large AABBs include HUD, silhouette and background, so they do not establish isolated paint sparkle.
Night pools are procedural flat ground quads. The owned shelter is partly obscured by a foreground bus in night_stop, and no controlled 1.8 lighting ratio was established.

Stable owned render callbacks report 11 to 20 calls including shadows. Seven of eight on/off comparisons agree, but bus day delta 13 differs from the owned count 17 by four calls. The composite attribution check is explicitly failed, not discarded.
Some glass, light and detail batches do not cast shadows. Full sub-metre seating raycasts and sunlight direction measurements remain unestablished.
The bus camera is much closer but its theoretical eye-to-centre distance is about 12.47 m, slightly beyond the literal 12 m requirement; the close bus also meets the bottom HUD.

Geometry chips have measured 21 px height but small pixel glyphs, limited characters and no depth occlusion; they can show through foliage. Routes and text are merged geometry rather than literal InstancedMesh for every element.

Own buses and traffic cars have no shared collision reservation and may overlap. Native input and treasury fiscal consumers are requested from the root integrator and are not claimed complete by this owner round.
Far LOD removes body detail, lamps and doors but retains the base body mesh. No tram, rail, catenary or platform stretch implementation.

Line.length retains the full road edge route sum for the public contract. Cached physical arcs are 1.5 to 1.8 percent shorter; actual headway and mean speed use the physical schedule, not a false edge-length speed.

pinnedStatistics.method: Full resolution pinned AABB crops, sRGB weighted luma 0..255, each interior pixel minus mean of eight neighbours. Crops include background, silhouette, glazing and HUD; this is the literal crop test, not isolated paint evidence. No crop images generated.

notes: All eight CS2 references and all 55 generated PNGs were visually inspected, including superseded iteration frames. Only final release, quality-stable and gauntlet-final evidence is used for the current result.
An early empty-city error from uninitialised ownStops was found and fixed before final captures. The historical failed empty-final artifact remains; empty-release has zero errors.
The initial quality probe used unstabilized global renderer deltas and mistook 22 unique served IDs for 24 scheduled dwells; corrected quality-stable retains the remaining real attribution mismatch.

Final core-camera gauntlet has 253 maximum whole-game calls, 2,074,027 maximum triangles and 56.9 minimum fps. Showcase all separately has 416 calls, 2,215,458 triangles and 29.4 fps, with zero errors. Whole-game and owned counts are intentionally distinct.
System Chrome 152 with actual Apple M4 ANGLE Metal through shared server 5174. These are not software renderer measurements.

Synthetic demand weights only apply when flags.showcase equals transit and the building collection is empty. Ordinary empty cities never use the fallback. Allocated inactive vehicles continue their documented daily operating cost; root consumer derives cost from balance rather than duplicating a constant.
Source is frozen at the listed SHA-256 hashes. No production files outside src/modules/transit were modified; core request and owned evidence/report only. No commits or score/status edits.
